description: Command-line tool that exports OpenSlide slides as Deep Zoom (like deepzoom_tile.py) or OME-Zarr. Bundles native OpenSlide from openslide-bin (LGPL-2.1); source: the openslide-bin source tarball named in licenses/openslide-bin/openslide-bin.json, also attached to the OpenSlideSharp GitHub release of the same version. Also bundles SkiaSharp (MIT) with Skia (BSD-3-Clause), System.CommandLine (MIT), and OpenSeadragon (BSD-3-Clause) with its public-domain scale bar plugin for the -r viewer. See LICENSE.txt and licenses/.
